title: Scorned Wilderness - Narrative Trailer | RuneScape: Dragonwilds
author: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
description:
Born as a weapon. Raised to the brink of divinity. Kuldra turned against her creators and survived the cataclysm that broke Ashenfall.

Now, she seeks to unleash a second cataclysm. One that will consume all of Gielinor.

General Zilyana is searching for champions. Answer the call. Face the Dragon Queen. Save Gielinor.

Coming September 15, 2026 on Steam, PS5, XBOX Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, the Epic Games Store and Jagex Launcher.

transcript.text: When the Dragonkin first set foot on Ashenfall, they marvelled at the wild anima
that flowed through the land and resolved to claim it.
They built the Harmonic Resonator, a device that harnessed raw anima, granting them immense power, and with it
they forged an empire. To safeguard it, they sought to create dragons.Servants.
Weapons. Born to obey. Kuldra was the first. Shaped… tested… broken…
to birth, a perfect race of dragons. But her children were deemed failures... and destroyed.
The Dragonkin fed her the blood of a goddess… raising her to the brink of divinity.
And at last... she gave them perfection. But with that divine power… Kuldra rose.
No longer their servant… but their reckoning And one by one… she devoured her creators
Until only Rasthin remained In desperation, she unleashed the Resonator,
a cataclysm meant to destroy Kuldra. Ashenfall was broken… but Kuldra endured.
Now, she gathers the remnants of the Resonator to unleash a second cataclysm. One that will consume all of Gielinor.
But hope remains. Guided by the god Saradomin, General Zilyana has come… seeking champions.
To face the Dragon Queen… and stop the end of the world
